Class FundingSourcesController

java.lang.Object
edu.ucsb.cs.taapply.controller.ApiController
edu.ucsb.cs.taapply.controller.FundingSourcesController
@RequestMapping("/api/admin/fundingSources") @RestController public class FundingSourcesController extends ApiController
The admin-maintained list of funding sources (issue #512): the abbreviations the financial office staff put on ULA hiring records, each with an explanation. Admins create, edit and delete them; hiring staff may read the list, since the Funding dropdown on the Soft Offer Results page needs it.

The abbreviation is the key, so it is not editable: only the explanation can change. It is stored as typed, after trimming, and compared case-sensitively. A source that hiring records (issue #509) still carry cannot be deleted: the staff clear those rows first (issue #512, part 2).
